name: Bokura no Sekai ni Shukufuku o.
source:
Kazuki took in a puppy that was on the verge of freezing to death on a cold rainy day in the middle of winter. He also let in a stray black kitty that often came to play with him. He welcomed both of them into his room and gave them food and warmth. Before he knew it, he fell asleep to the faint sound of raindrops and the whir of the heater.

When he woke up the next morning, there were two naked girls by his side. It appeared that the animals had turned into humans and wanted to repay him for his kindness.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/11/08/november-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
寒冷多雨的隆冬，和树收留了一只濒临冻死的小狗。他也让一只经常来找他玩的黑色流浪猫进了房间，给它们食物和温暖。不知不觉间，他在微弱的雨声与暖气运转声中睡着了。

第二天早上醒来时，他身边出现了两名一丝不挂的女孩。原来，那些动物变成了人类，想报答他给予的善意。

[来自 [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/11/08/november-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
